name: Lead Payback
office_task: Each month, publish which ad campaign or lead source our jobs came from and what we invoiced on them, every figure traced to the job and invoice records.
systems_of_record: the job system (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify, Fergus and the like): the lead source field and accepted quote on each job_id
the ledger (Xero or MYOB): invoices and credit notes raised in the month, each carrying its job_id in the reference
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the month's lead source report per audience (owner: jobs won and invoiced value per lead source; marketing contractor: jobs won only), each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time or published as unavailable with the reason, jobs with no lead source recorded counted as their own line; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the period's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a job system or ledger read that failed, a lead source line with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the period, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner
